cash_tip: Locals say the standalone ATMs in Sayulita charge high fees, so use a bank ATM, always choose 'decline conversion' so you're charged in pesos, take out a bigger amount once, and keep small bills handy for tacos, taxis and the market. If you happen to be in San Pancho, the ATM at the hospital there is reported to be the cheapest for US cards (about 60 pesos).
